name: Whisper_Compatible_SER_benchmark
description: A small benchmark adapted for evaluating speech emotion recognition (SER) in settings compatible with Whisper-style ASR and audio preprocessing. It measures models' ability to recognize speaker affect from short utterances, typically as a multi-class emotion classification problem. The dataset is packaged to be easy to run with Whisper-based pipelines and focuses on robustness to ASR-induced noise.
reputation: Niche community dataset hosted on Hugging Face for Whisper-compatible SER experiments; limited but growing adoption among practitioners experimenting with ASR-robust emotion classification.
